ck_charge_void.name: ck_charge_void
ck_charge_void.value: ((status = 'void'::text) = (void_kind IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status = 'void'::text) = (voided_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status = 'void'::text) = (voided_by IS NOT NULL))

ck_charge_void_reason.name: ck_charge_void_reason
ck_charge_void_reason.value: ((NOT (void_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'single'::text)) = (void_reason IS NOT NULL)) AND ((void_reason IS NULL) OR ((char_length(btrim(void_reason)) >= 5) AND (char_length(btrim(void_reason)) <= 500)))

ck_charge_line_note.name: ck_charge_line_note
ck_charge_line_note.value: ((kind = 'fee'::text) OR ((note IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(note) <> ''::text))) AND ((note IS NULL) OR (char_length(note) <= 500))

ck_fake_gateway_link_paid.name: ck_fake_gateway_link_paid
ck_fake_gateway_link_paid.value: (status = 'paid'::text) <= ((paid_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (paid_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_fee_batch_closed.name: ck_fee_batch_closed
ck_fee_batch_closed.value: ((status = 'closed'::text) = (closed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((closed_at IS NULL) = (closed_by IS NULL))

ck_fee_batch_published.name: ck_fee_batch_published
ck_fee_batch_published.value: ((status = 'draft'::text) = (published_at IS NULL)) AND ((published_at IS NULL) = (published_by IS NULL))

ck_fee_batch_recalled.name: ck_fee_batch_recalled
ck_fee_batch_recalled.value: ((status = 'recalled'::text) = (recalled_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((recalled_at IS NULL) = (recalled_by IS NULL))

ck_gateway_event_review.name: ck_gateway_event_review
ck_gateway_event_review.value: ((reviewed_at IS NULL) = (reviewed_by IS NULL)) AND ((reviewed_at IS NULL) = (review_note IS NULL))

ck_payment_online.name: ck_payment_online
ck_payment_online.value: ((source = 'online'::text) AND (provider IS NOT NULL) AND (gateway_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (client_key IS NULL) AND (recorded_by IS NULL) AND (statement_line_id IS NULL)) OR ((source = ANY (ARRAY['cash'::text, 'bank_transfer'::text])) AND (provider IS NULL) AND (gateway_reference IS NULL) AND (intent_id IS NULL) AND (client_key IS NOT NULL) AND (recorded_by IS NOT NULL) AND (payer_name IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(payer_name) <> ''::text))

ck_payment_void.name: ck_payment_void
ck_payment_void.value: ((status = 'void'::text) = (voided_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((voided_at IS NULL) = (voided_by IS NULL)) AND ((voided_at IS NULL) = (void_reason IS NULL))

ck_payment_intent_cancelling.name: ck_payment_intent_cancelling
ck_payment_intent_cancelling.value: (status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelling'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) OR ((cancel_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_payment_intent_paid.name: ck_payment_intent_paid
ck_payment_intent_paid.value: ((status = 'paid'::text) = (paid_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((paid_at IS NULL) = (gateway_reference IS NULL))

ck_statement_import_counts.name: ck_statement_import_counts
ck_statement_import_counts.value: (line_count >= (credit_count + duplicate_count)) AND (credit_count >= 0) AND (duplicate_count >= 0) AND ((matched_count >= 0) AND (matched_count <= credit_count))

ck_statement_import_period.name: ck_statement_import_period
ck_statement_import_period.value: ((period_from IS NULL) = (period_to IS NULL)) AND (period_from <= period_to)

ck_statement_line_review.name: ck_statement_line_review
ck_statement_line_review.value: ((reviewed_at IS NULL) = (reviewed_by IS NULL)) AND ((reviewed_at IS NULL) = (review_note IS NULL))
